credits.overview: Ranjan Dubey, Lucknow's most eligible bachelor, finds his search for a bride taking an unexpected turn when Helen, his charming new househelp, walks into his life. With everyone having an opinion on this unlikely duo, will their companionship blossom into love?

credits.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

credits.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
credits.overview: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

credits.title: Rajni Ki Baraat
credits.overview: A girl decides to take the reins of destiny in her own hands by organizing her own wedding procession after her boyfriend's egotistic and violent sadistic policeman father fixes his wedding somewhere else.

credits.title: Pinch
credits.overview: When Maitri, an aspiring travel blogger, is groped by her landlord while traveling to a festival, she impulsively takes retributive steps. The ramifications rock her tight-knit community in this darkly comic exploration of guilt, trauma and the strength it takes to stand up to power.

credits.title: Silent Cycle
credits.overview: A 12-year-old girl must take a stand against her conservative grandmother after being excluded from a family ritual upon getting her first period.

credits.overview: A stay-at-home husband struggles with societal judgment as his ambitious wife becomes the primary breadwinner. In a small-town setting, their unconventional roles spark humor, conflict, and self-discovery. credits.title: Stree 2
credits.overview: Following the events of 'Stree', the town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity. Once again, it's up to Vicky and friends to save their town and loved ones.

credits.title: Santosh
credits.overview: A government scheme sees newly widowed Santosh inherit her husband’s job as a police constable in the rural badlands of Northern India. When a low-caste girl is found raped and murdered, she is pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma.

credits.title: Kaisi Ye Dor
credits.overview: Set in the backdrop of the spiritual capital of India, Banaras, the essence of relationships which seems to be missing in the present day is brought forth.

credits.title: Sab Moh Maaya Hai
credits.overview: The film is a poignant father- son story set in Ujjain. Inspired by true life, it deals with the sensitivity of unemployment, the selfless love of a father, and the behaviour of a selfish son, with quirk and humour.

credits.title: The Conversion
credits.overview: A Movie that explores the sensitive topic of religious conversion, this movie is a captivating drama depicting girl's dilemma of what happens in an inter-faith marriage that results in religious conversion.

credits.title: Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan
credits.overview: Partners Karthik and Aman don't have it easy in their road to achieving a happy ending, while Aman's family tries to get him married to someone else, Karthik doesn't step down unless he marries Aman.  A sequel to the 2017 film, titled Shubh Mangal Saavdhan.

credits.title: Bala
credits.overview: A man suffering from alopecia copes with his lack of self-confidence and the societal pressure that comes with being bald.

credits.title: Kedarnath
credits.overview: Mansoor, a reserved and reticent Pithoo (porter), helps pilgrims make an arduous journey upwards to the temple town. His world turns around when he meets the beautiful and rebellious Mukku who draws him into a whirlwind of intense love.

credits.title: Stree
credits.overview: Set in the town of Chanderi, Stree is based on the urban legend of Nale Ba that went viral in Karnataka in the 1990s, and features Shraddha Kapoor and Rajkummar Rao in pivotal roles.

credits.title: Kaphal: Wild Berries
credits.overview: Two boys attempt to send their strict father back to the city with the help of a forest witch, but instead get taken for a merry ride by her granddaughter.

credits.title: Striker
credits.overview: Amidst strictly enforced curfew by Bombay Police during December 1992 following Hindu-Muslim riots, Suryakant - one of four siblings from Malad's Malvani slums, heads home.
